in_sanskrit.name: Sakal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है All, Entire, Whole
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sakal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sakal means the entirety, the whole, all-encompassing, complete. It can be used to describe a situation where everything is included, or as a name for a deity who represents the all-pervading presence of the divine.

It can be used to describe a situation where everything is included, or as a name for a deity who represents the all-pervading presence of the divine.
